{{Top|leg}}
'''Division Three''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Taxation Bureau]], created to investigate and fight against [[Black market/Legends|black market]] trade. Division Three was a [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] detachment with loose ties to the Bureau, and waged an aggressive campaign against [[black marketeer]]s. Under Division Three's scrutiny, small businesses that evaded [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureaucracy were targeted, such as unlicensed food vendors and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] shops. Division Three's methods were unnecessarily violent, with up to seventy percent of individuals arrested needed medical attention. While successful as a campaign against the black market, many of the affected [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] or their families ended up joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Division Three operatives were either [[Division Three Field Agent|Field Agents]] or [[Division Three Assault Trooper|Assault Troopers]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Tel Terlou]] worked in Division Three and planned to crack-down on black market activity in the [[Estaria Central Starport]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
